title: SharePoint News: cross-post published news posts to Viva Engage communities and storylines
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, publishing permissions, licensing qualifications and storyline control match Microsoft's sources. Targeted searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps for a cross-posting tenant switch and storyline-creator automation.

claims.claim: Publishers can distribute a published SharePoint news post to a Viva Engage community or storyline.
claims.quote: SharePoint News to Engage cross-posting lets creators distribute a published SharePoint News post to a Viva Engage community or storyline.

claims.claim: Comments are shared and synchronized across SharePoint and Engage as one discussion.
claims.quote: Comments and reactions are synchronized across SharePoint and Engage. A person can engage from either product, and participate in the same discussion for the news post.

claims.claim: The storyline-creator setting is at Engage admin center > Feature management > Storyline > Advanced Settings > Edit > Specify storyline creators.
claims.quote:
from the Engage admin center, go to Feature management > Storyline.
2. Select Edit in Advanced Settings.
3. Switch Specify storyline creators to Eligible users from selected group.

claims.claim: No API or automation is documented for the Specify storyline creators setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage Specify storyline creators setting API PowerShell Microsoft Graph storyline privileges selected group. Opened eac-storyline, Graph engagement-api-overview and beta storyline resource; found community/role and following APIs, not a creator-setting operation.
